title: POSTERIOR & STRETCH
subtitle: WEDNESDAY EASE. SOFT BACK. GENTLE REACH.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Wednesday is soft posterior work and a gentle stretch — a small break from the desk, nothing fierce. About eleven minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Soft back, a gentle stretch, and you showed up. Enjoy your Wednesday — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Light hand weights optional — empty hands are fine. Reach the arms forward softly, then draw the elbows back as if squeezing a soft cushion between the shoulder blades. Soft neck, chest open. Smaller squeeze is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, reach forward softly, then draw the elbows back and open the chest. Soft neck. Empty hands are fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the upper back. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SIT TO STAND
exercises.cue: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat under the knees. Soft belly. Lean a little forward and stand tall with control, then sit back down gently. Hands on thighs or the chair for support if you like. Soft knees, no bounce. Smaller stand or a partial rise is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Sit to stand. Two sets of six. Soft belly, lean a little forward, stand tall, then sit back gently. Use the chair if you like. Partial rise is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Thirty seconds. Soften the legs. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Sit to stand done. Steady work.

exercises.name: SEATED FORWARD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Hinge gently from the hips and reach the hands forward toward the floor or your shins — only as far as feels kind. Soft neck, easy breath. Hold about twenty seconds, then stack tall again. Smaller reach is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated forward reach. Two holds of about twenty seconds. Soft belly, hinge gently from the hips, reach only as far as feels kind. Soft neck.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the back. Easy breath.

exercises.name: CHAIR BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand beside a sturdy chair, light hand on the backrest. Softly shift weight onto one foot and lift the other heel or foot a little. Hold about twenty seconds, then switch. Use the chair as much as you need. Soft tall posture, easy breath. Smaller hold is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance. Two sets of about twenty seconds each side. Light hand on the chair, soft weight on one foot, lift the other a little. Use the chair as much as you need.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Shake it out. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Balance done. That's the session — lovely work.
